name: Spring Shred: 8 Week Fat Loss Workout Plan
description: Five weekly sessions with warm-ups, paired exercises and final-set intensity methods. Rest shortens over eight weeks.
schedule: Repeat Chest & Abs, Back, Shoulders, Arms and Legs each week for eight weeks. The article does not assign weekdays or rest days. Working-set / superset-round rest: weeks 1–2 = 120s; weeks 3–4 = 90s; weeks 5–6 = 60s; weeks 7–8 = 45s. Choose the current week’s rest manually; the app does not change timers by week.
progression: Working-set / superset-round rest: weeks 1–2 = 120s; weeks 3–4 = 90s; weeks 5–6 = 60s; weeks 7–8 = 45s. Choose the current week’s rest manually; the app does not change timers by week. No fixed load-increase rule is supplied.
notes: Source duration: 45–60 minutes. Intensity methods apply to the last working set only (author reply to Adi, 17 Sep 2025). Warm-ups are explicit targets. Failure work, holds and intensity methods are described in exercise notes, not invented numeric targets. Supersets retain A/B order. Working-set / superset-round rest: weeks 1–2 = 120s; weeks 3–4 = 90s; weeks 5–6 = 60s; weeks 7–8 = 45s. Choose the current week’s rest manually; the app does not change timers by week. Cardio guidance: 20 minutes of HIIT, 3–4 times/week or adjusted to goals; separate from weights if possible, otherwise afterward. Warm up 2 min, then 8 rounds of 30s hard / 90s low–moderate, then cool down 2 min. Cardio is guidance, not extra strength days.
